findings.message: 19.P3.serve-activation requires one shared Journal and reuse of the existing triage/Author path. triage_pass internally constructs Driver.from_config, which creates a separate Journal and Effects owner, and exposes no binding seam for the caller to supply checkout.journal. Satisfying this custody requirement requires an edit outside the earned fence; copying triage or replacing its writer through runtime monkeypatching would violate the governing contract.
